propositions: Literal section-heading requirements reject valid plans whose mechanism is expressed in semantic aliases (e.g., Why/What instead of Approach); historical tickets pass both attestations despite missing canonical headings.
Exact lexicon matchers for placeholder phrases flag mechanically decidable bounded conditionals as deferred design choices; the distinction requires semantic applicability, not phrase-counting.
Per-AC proof-coverage markers are not a validity threshold; historical tickets with zero verify-with sentinels but precise behavioral assertions pass attestation.
Unconditional edit-set requirements (file_impact nonempty) fail on valid read-only analysis and operational tickets with explicit no-edit output contracts and durable ticket-comment results.
AC conjunction counts cannot distinguish bundled independent matrix deliverables from vague hedges; splitting coherent cross-surface invariants obscures intent and duplicates setup.
Testing section taxonomy requirements (happy+negative scenarios) should apply only after semantic applicability establishes user-facing behavior, not merely because a Testing heading exists.
